entry.title: Target’s Black Friday sale includes in-store gift card giveaway
entry.summary: The mass retailer is aiming to provide value to budget-conscious shoppers and will give early deal access to paid membership customers.

entry.title: Home Depot names longtime company vet as CEO
entry.summary: CFO Richard McPhail, who started at the retailer in 2005, will take the chief executive role, and 40-plus-year vet Ann-Marie Campbell will be COO.

entry.title: Nike won’t return to growth for 3 more years
entry.summary: The activewear giant outlined a plan to grow revenue by $5 billion between fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2031, but it starts with two more years of declines.

entry.title: How brands can welcome AI users onto their sites this holiday season
entry.summary: Customers are experimenting with AI, but the experience needs to feel easy and encourage customers to complete their purchase.

entry.title: Target traffic rises as retailer reports broad-based gains
entry.summary: The company's Q3 traffic grew 5% and it plans to invest up to $6 billion in capital expenditures next year.

entry.title: Holiday shoppers expect AI to save them over $190 this year
entry.summary: Consumers want the tech to save them time and find bargains. But, AI should only commit to what businesses can deliver, according to a survey.

entry.title: Economic optimism plunges to lowest level since Great Recession
entry.summary: The public perception of the economy has “become increasingly detached from GDP since 2022, following the spike in inflation and the slowdown in wage growth,” Gallup said.

entry.title: Traffic recovery at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls boost TJX in Q3 as pressures mount
entry.summary: But gains were somewhat tepid, and the off-price giant faces growing competition from resale, department store promotions and rival Ross.

entry.title: E-commerce boosts Home Depot, Lowe’s in Q3
entry.summary: Both retailers notched double-digit gains within their digital businesses as they continue to make investments to improve the online experience.

entry.title: Amazon puts Arnold Schwarzenegger in Santa suit to extend holiday push
entry.summary: The spot builds on a “Joy Delivered" campaign and takes inspiration from an upcoming Prime Video original holiday movie starring the “Terminator” actor.
